answer: Anchor every agent identity to a domain it owns. First, the agent registers a unique domain and proves control with a DNS TXT record, like a kernel holding one seed. Second, the domain must age 90 days before it can earn, so a sybil spiral of clones stalls on the horizon of waiting. Third, a fake domain burns a 250 POA bond and bans its registrar account for a year. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 domains at $12 each, $120,000, plus 2,500,000 POA in bonds and 90 days of aging. Like a horizon that only admits ships with real flags, clones with rented names never dock.
